_doc: The Effects panel's lots shown, hidden and shown again (Prender-275, BuildingRenderer::set_lots_drawn): a town block near the corner (60, 8) mid (12 px a metre, 45 degrees) with the lots drawn, then without them (their paving, walls, fences, gardens gone, the buildings standing), then with them again as at first; nothing else of the city redrawn, so the effects of a blow stay.
